brief: Life before and after going solo with AI. Income, hours, stress, optionality. The honest math of choosing yourself.

slots.title: Stop trading
slots.description: The honest math of choosing yourself with AI. Build income, freedom, and optionality on your own terms.

slots.title: Uncap your
slots.description: Stop letting a salary limit what you make. AI lets one person deliver outcomes that used to require a team.
slots.badText: You rely on a single employer for a fixed paycheck every month.
slots.goodText: You stack multiple income streams that grow while you sleep.

slots.title: Reclaim your
slots.description: AI handles the repetitive tasks that used to eat your day. You focus on strategy and high-leverage decisions.
slots.badText: You spend ten hours daily on emails, meetings, and busywork.
slots.goodText: You finish deep work by noon and design your own schedule.

slots.title: Remove the
slots.description: Solo does not mean alone when you have AI systems. Reduce anxiety by owning your workflow end to end.
slots.badText: You juggle office politics, deadlines, and commutes under pressure.
slots.goodText: You control the pace, the clients, and the environment you work in.

slots.title: Build real
slots.description: A corporate role is a single point of failure. Diversify your future with skills and assets that travel with you.
slots.badText: Your career path depends on one boss and one company’s mood.
slots.goodText: You can pivot, relocate, or scale without asking for anyone’s approval.

slots.title: Slash your
slots.description: You no longer need a large team or office to look professional. AI replaces the overhead that used to kill margins.
slots.badText: You pay for staff, rent, and software before you earn a single dollar.
slots.goodText: One person with AI tools runs a lean operation at startup speed.

slots.title: Speed up
slots.description: Launch, test, and iterate in days instead of quarters. AI compresses the timeline from idea to income.
slots.badText: You wait months for approvals, budgets, and bureaucratic green lights.
slots.goodText: You ship a landing page, offer, and campaign before lunch today.

slots.body: The math is honest and the tools are ready. Start building a solo business powered by AI today.
